comment: The registry of every skill in the collection, and where each one lives.
A skill lives with what it describes: tool skills in the tool's repo, method
skills here, site skills behind that site's access boundary.
tier   public   | anyone can clone the source
embargoed| private while the tool is in early development; goes public with it
gated    | permanently access-controlled; never appears in a public artifact
pending  set when the source repo does not exist yet; the builder skips it

It belongs in the PureCLIP maintainers' repository, but the destination is unsettled: skrakau/PureCLIP is upstream 1.3.1 and johan-stph/PureCLIP is the maintained 2.0.4 fork with renamed short flags. The skill documents parameters, so it must follow whichever the maintainers ship.
